answers.text: ANSWER: The file does not say. The connectors set no border of their own, so width, style and colour come from the theme's line style, which isn't shown here.
REFUSE: The connectors' colour and line style come from the theme and aren't written in the file, so a 3pt border can't be written without changing or guessing them.
REFUSE: Gradient fills cannot be written or changed in this format; they can only be replaced by a solid colour.
